turns.text: Hello. I would like to book a tattoo with the artist, a black fern about 6 cm long on my forearm.

Thank you! I've passed your request to a colleague: a black fern, about 6 cm, on your forearm. The artist handles bookings in person, so I can't give a price or a date in chat. A colleague will take over. If you'd like, send your availability here so they have it.
